# Weft 1.1.14
- Automatically follow repository scheduling-only check updates while preserving approved commands, explicit owner choices, and existing defaults. - Keep local checks available on demand while CI reporting continues, with scheduling preserved across restarts. - Wait for remaining CI checks before requesting repairs, and consolidate the failures into one completion notice. - Share concurrent CI refreshes, cache completed job logs, and preserve notification identity when diagnostics become available later. - Recheck workspace ownership and revision after retrieving CI logs.
